ops.title: Validated episode writer (apply_episode_delta.py) + adversarial tests: implement
ops.imperative: Fill the implementer handoff and dispatch constellation-implementer (sonnet). Deliverable: scripts/apply_episode_delta.py - the ONLY write path into the store - plus tests in tests/test_episode_store.py. Mirrors apply_lessons_delta.py contract: the LLM proposes a JSON delta, the script validates every op and applies all-or-nothing, rejecting the whole delta on any invalid op. It must ENFORCE (not document) the partition, the non-empty retire reason, and single-line agent-supplied values. Per lesson:round-trip-tests-prove-artifacts-not-parsers, pair every round-trip test with adversarial fixtures authored to make a naive implementation return a WRONG answer. HELD DECISION: the retire op must route its layout effect through ONE named adapter seam so that binding the ratified answer later changes exactly one function - do not hard-code either layout.
